verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a VPN and network-connectivity product, so directing an agent to perform repository operations (browse, search, edit, commit, pull, push) falls outside its category. The Tailscale skill and the Aperture CLI only route or configure third-party coding agents. They do not show Tailscale itself performing repository operations through conversation, so the exception for a shipped wrong-axis capability does not apply.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can direct an AI agent to browse, search, edit, commit, pull, and push in a repository via conversation
